newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume firms.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume firms.

text.p: Gold prices were mixed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Friday and volume crept up on limited demand from the free market, dealers said.
Gold closed $1.60 lower at $380.90 an ounce as prices fell towards the key $380 level in Europe.
But it gained 750 lira to 1,123,250 lira per gramme due to a weak Turkish lira which closed at 91,400 against the dollar after Thursday's 91,300.
Traded volume increased 5.7 percent to 1,018 kg.

"The drop in international markets and income tax payments by jewellers (due end-September) is negatively affecting free market demand. But those who expect gold to hold above the 380 mark were buying today," said Yusuf Kiremitci from Sembol Doviz, a foreign exchange and gold shop in the free market.
Dealers expect demand to rise on Monday after weekend gold jewellery and coin sales in the free market.
Volume was 575 kg in the first session and 443 in the second. 70.5 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms.
